entries.title: 'No light, no water, no heat': Ukrainians struggle with blackouts as Russia hits power grid
entries.snippet: For parents in parts of Ukraine, trying to lead a normal family life with just a few hours of power each day is taking its toll.

entries.title: New York City building collapse kills several people
entries.snippet: A dangerous search for survivors continues after a three-storey building collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday afternoon.

entries.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
entries.snippet: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

entries.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
entries.snippet: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

entries.title: Ukraine says military Starlink disrupted again as US envoys meet Putin in Moscow
entries.snippet: Later on Thursday, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will travel to Dublin to meet Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky.

entries.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
entries.snippet: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.

entries.title: British woman missing from cruise ship in Atlantic
entries.snippet: The 72-year-old was last seen aboard the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.

entries.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
entries.snippet: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

entries.title: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive
entries.snippet: The 17-year-old's mum has joked that he is "grounded for life" and "never leaving the house again".

entries.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
entries.snippet: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

entries.title: Famed ship SS United States deliberately sunk off Florida coast to become a reef
entries.snippet: Activists wanted the historic liner to be turned into a museum, but it will instead become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

entries.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
entries.snippet: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.

entries.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
entries.snippet: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

entries.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued after being buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
entries.snippet: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

entries.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
entries.snippet: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

entries.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
entries.snippet: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

entries.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
entries.snippet: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

entries.title: African writing award probe finds 'no evidence' winning story was AI generated
entries.snippet: Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has also vehemently denied the allegation made in a US magazine.

entries.title: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
entries.snippet: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

entries.title: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
entries.snippet: Following a ceremony marking Veterans Day, a group that included Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth was shouted at to be quiet.

entries.title: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
entries.snippet: After more than a week of counting ballots, Scott Colom has narrowly won the Mississippi Senate seat. And, the White House has sent a letter warning Democrats who plan to investigate the administration.

entries.title: How Scott Colom defied the odds to go from district attorney to Mississippi's Democratic US Senator
entries.snippet: In a state that hasn't had a Democrat in office since 1980 and hasn't sent a Black Senator to Washington since the 1870s, Colom's win represents a massive upset in state politics.

entries.title: A blue wave helped offset for now a falling tally of Black members in the U.S. House
entries.snippet: A Supreme Court ruling that further weakened the Voting Rights Act paved the way for a record drop in Black representation in Congress. But a midterm blue wave helped hold off such a decline for now.

entries.title: Senators don't always share bill text online before votes. They should, advocates say
entries.snippet: The text of what lawmakers are considering isn't always made available for public review before it is voted on. A group of open governance advocates is calling on Senate leadership for a change.

entries.title: Trump proposed a 'secret weapon' to police colleges. It will soon become reality
entries.snippet: In a 2023 campaign speech, Trump pledged to reclaim universities from what he called the radical left. His Education Department just finalized a rule to help him do it.

entries.title: At least 23 states considered laws governing ICE and schools this year
entries.snippet: When ICE agents show up at a school, educators rely on a patchwork of policies to know what to do. This year, many state legislatures tried to update those policies.

entries.title: Kennedy Center plans Ticketmaster switch, raising conflict of interest concerns
entries.snippet: The Kennedy Center's former president Richard Grenell was a paid board member of Ticketmaster's parent company at the same time the two parties were negotiating.

entries.title: Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital kills 6 people, health authorities say
entries.snippet: The victims included a surgeon, and dozens more were injured. Israel said it was targeting a Hamas commander and other militants.

entries.title: World's fastest ocean liner is sunk to break another record: largest artificial reef
entries.snippet: The SS United States broke trans-Atlantic speed records. On Wednesday, it was sunk off the Florida coast and will become a diving destination and home for marine life.

entries.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins the closest Senate race in the country
entries.snippet: Mississippi hadn't elected a Democrat to the U.S. Senate in more than 40 years.

entries.title: Indictment sheds light on alleged Iran-backed plots across U.S. and Europe

entries.title: Sen. Coons on Huang affair, Iran war and why Trump should fire Hegseth

entries.title: How companies are using AI to make you spend more money
entries.snippet: Companies have always tried to maximize profits, but now there are a host of sophisticated tools to determine the prices of the goods and services they sell. At a time when so many Americans are frustrated with rising costs, those tools are under greater scrutiny. Economics corre

entries.title: How America's military shaped the nation's history and evolved over 250 years
entries.snippet: Over the last 250 years, the United States military has helped shape the nation's history – from the fight for independence to its emergence as the world's leading military power. But as the military's reach has grown, fewer Americans are serving in uniform. Judy Woodruff explore

entries.title: New film 'The Mosquito Bowl' tells story of WWII football game between Marines
entries.snippet: The themes of service to country and reflection on humanity are at the center of the new film "The Mosquito Bowl." Special correspondent Mike Cerre caught up with some of the forces behind the film and the real historical event. It's part of our arts and culture series, CANVAS.

entries.title: Scott Colom wins Senate election in Mississippi
entries.snippet: Democratic nominee Scott Colom has defeated Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi's closely contested U.S. Senate race after a prolonged ballot counting process, giving the state its first Black U.S. senator since post-Civil War Reconstruction.

entries.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a large prisoner exchange as talks end with no major breakthrough
entries.snippet: Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war, both sides said Wednesday as two days of U.S.-mediated talks concluded with no major breakthrough on ending Moscow's nearly 5-year-old full-scale invasion.

entries.title: 4 key findings in the Jeffrey Epstein report from GOP-led House Oversight panel
entries.snippet: Jeffrey Epstein's crimes committed after 2005 could have been prevented, barring "repeated failures" from law enforcement and federal prosecutors. That's one of the findings in a report published Tuesday by the House Oversight Committee after an investigation into the late convic

entries.title: Biden says he wouldn't have run for a second term in 2024 if he knew he had cancer
entries.snippet: Joe Biden says he did not know he had cancer while he was president and would not have sought a second term if he already had been diagnosed.

entries.title: Judge allows Trump defamation case against BBC to proceed but tosses 1 claim
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation case against the BBC remains on track, for the moment.

entries.title: Trump says the towering arch he wants to be build might be dedicated to military veterans
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump observed Veterans Day by suggesting that the towering arch he wants to build in his own honor would also be dedicated to the U.S. military and those who served in its ranks.

entries.title: Missing South Carolina infant rescued after being buried alive in a dog crate for 24 hours
entries.snippet: When an 11-month-old infant was reported missing in South Carolina, dozens of first responders combed the countryside for the "bright boy with reddish blond hair" who, the sheriff's office said, had disappeared while his grandmother ran errands.

entries.title: More than a dozen key races remain too early to call one week after Election Day
entries.snippet: The size of Democrats' majorities in the House and Senate remained undetermined one week after Election Day as more than a dozen races were still too early to call Tuesday.

entries.title: How Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's extramarital affair could cause collateral damage in Washington
entries.snippet: Extramarital affairs are usually private matters. Jensen Huang's has global implications.

entries.title: AP report: Bessent moves to a military base over safety concerns
entries.snippet: Recent U.S. intelligence showed that Iran has stepped up efforts to target American personnel in the Middle East and elsewhere.

entries.title: Read the letter the White House's top lawyer sent Rep. Garcia over threats to investigate Trump
entries.snippet: The White House's top lawyer sent a letter of warning to incoming House Oversight Committee chair Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif., on Wednesday, claiming that the Democrats' promise to investigate the Trump administration "may cross the line into blatant criminality."

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: SS United States, once world's fastest ocean liner, sinks to become reef off Florida
entries.snippet: The historic ocean liner SS United States will be intentionally sunk Wednesday off the coast of the Florida panhandle.

entries.title: White House sends warning to Democrats about investigating the Trump administration
entries.snippet: The White House has issued a warning to Democrats over their planned probes into the Trump administration, going as far as claiming that such investigations — a standard oversight function of Congress -- may amount to "blatant criminality."

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Israel targets senior Hamas member in Gaza hospital strike
entries.snippet: Israel says Hamas was using the hospital as a military command center, while Palestinian officials report at least six people killed, including a surgeon. The strike comes amid an increasingly fragile ceasefire.

entries.title: Germany news: Police raid chapters of Gremium MC biker gang
entries.snippet: Police in southwestern Germany launched major early-morning operations against a biker gang. The state of Baden-Württemberg is outlawing three of its chapters. Meanwhile, unions are planning more strikes. Follow DW.

entries.title: Australian teen found alive after six days in the bush
entries.snippet: The teenager was spotted during an aerial search, after spending days navigating rugged terrain. He had fallen down the side of a riverbed two days before being found.

entries.title: Bundeswehr study exposes widespread sexual harassment in German military
entries.snippet: Sexual misconduct in the Bundeswehr is far more widespread than previously known, with younger women disproportionately affected. Defense Minister Boris Pistorius has called for a policy of "zero tolerance."

entries.title: Intelligent women get less help at work, study finds
entries.snippet: Women who scored high on intelligence tests were seen as more hostile by their teammates and got less help, a new study finds. High-scoring men faced no such penalty. Research explains why.

entries.title: India news : Modi government approves $340 million museum in Delhi
entries.snippet: The government says that the 'Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum' will have the world's "largest" museum dispaly area." DW has the latest.

entries.title: Ukraine peace talks: US envoys arrive in Russia to meet with Putin
entries.snippet: The US president's son-in-law Jared Kushner and envoy Steve Witkoff are in Russia to meet Vladimir Putin. The expected meeting comes after two days of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Where the US's war with Iran stands after the midterms
entries.snippet: Almost nine months after it began, the war in Iran has calmed to the point where Donald Trump sees an end. But with the key issues of the conflict unresolved and political change in the US, what is the situation?

entries.title: Pope Leo XIV returns to Peru to a big welcome, calls it his 'homeland'
entries.snippet: An estimated 3 million people greeted Pope Leo XIV in Lima as the Peruvian-citizen pontiff began a six-day homecoming visit to the country where he spent two decades as a missionary and bishop.

entries.title: Nvidia board reportedly weighs ousting Huang amid alleged affairs with exec and suspected Chinese spy
entries.snippet: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to oust Jensen Huang amid reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The shake-up would leave the world's leading AI chip supplier without the co-founder who built it.

entries.title: Mississippi Senate race: Democrat Scott Colom defeats Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith
entries.snippet: The southern US state of Mississippi has elected its first Black senator in more than 140 years. Democrat Scott Colom has won the seat in a historic upset, according to projections.

entries.title: Russian Foreign Ministry says its ambassador to US has died
entries.snippet: Russia's Foreign Ministry has said that Alexander Darchiev died from a chronic illness at the age of 66. The long-time diplomat had been in the Washington post since early 2025.

entries.title: Spain: Housing crisis prompts general strike, mass nighttime protests
entries.snippet: Hundreds of thousands of citizens have hit the streets to protest Spain's housing crisis after millions of union workers staged a general strike. The crisis has triggered snap elections to take place on November 29.

entries.title: Fears of rising antisemitism in Europe
entries.snippet: Holocaust survivor Regina Sluszny commemorates the victims of Auschwitz as Jewish communities across Europe face growing hostility. What does the promise of "Never Again" mean for Jewish life in Europe today?

entries.title: VW scraps production modernization plan citing tough financial straits
entries.snippet: VW has announced that it will scrap large-scale modernization in light of its current economic situation. Employee representatives accuse leadership of putting short-term profits before long-term company viability.

entries.title: Integration of immigrants in Germany: Much has been accomplished but problems remain
entries.snippet: The Federal Office for Migration and Refugees has released a new Integration Report. It found that while the integration of people with a migrant background is improving, violent youth remain a problem.

entries.title: Democracy study: One-quarter of Germans want a right-wing authoritarian dictatorship
entries.snippet: The far-right AfD's electoral successes point to a new trend in Germany: Prejudice, resentment, and extremism are on the rise. A new study suggests satisfaction with democracy is at a low ebb.

entries.title: Kenya's last Ebola patient leaves hospital
entries.snippet: Kenya had nine confirmed cases, while DR Congo continues to battle its deadliest outbreak of the disease.

entries.title: Brazil electoral court fines Meta, sees no deliberate election bias
entries.snippet: The fine came after President Lula's coalition filed a complaint. The court said there was no evidence of intent to influence the election. Meta said it will defend itself against "false allegations."
